note: Pre-registered before any paper results. Do not edit thresholds or the validation test to fit results; changing anything starts a new version with a fresh record.

sizing.note: Stake = quarter-Kelly on the blended probability, clipped to [min_units, max_units]; bets for a week are taken in order of edge until max_units_per_week is reached.

lock: A paper bet is recorded once, at the first run where it qualifies, at the best price available then. Later runs never change it.

validation.clv_definition: bet decimal odds x closing no-vig probability of that side - 1
